preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of constraints m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= ri <= n and 0 <= qi < 2**30 for li, ri, qi in constraints)
preconditions.description: Each constraint must have valid indices and a valid value within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: If no interesting array exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by n integers.

postconditions.expression: all((a[li-1] & a[ri-1]) == qi for li, ri, qi in constraints)
postconditions.description: The output array must satisfy all the given constraints.
